grains.RAW.PLANS: one row per microinsurance plan (one microinsurance product written in one Philippine city)
grains.RAW.PLAN_DAILY: one row per plan per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CLAIM_DOCUMENTS: one row per plan (claim file document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.escalation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(a claim on the plan is escalated to claims investigation in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio-wide claims-volume FORECAST; claim document rejection rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.CLAIMS_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic claims-handling SOPs (one per microinsurance product and claim cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.MICROINSURANCE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.MICROINSURANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, plan, claim-cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (plans, daily claims, escalations by plan, escalation risk, claim events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_CLAIMS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_CLAIMS_ALERT logs new REFERRED claims to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
